reason: Authoritative v1.3 guide: upgrade order, catalog embeddings declaration, default-model slots, retrieval profile, §5 acceptance checklist.
Prior increment: capability declaration pattern, ports, key minting, error semantics — all reused.
Conventions and layering; llm/ is the only provider-SDK layer.
Embedding provider construction (from_settings), dim used in request param, response-width validation, cache key; discovery must feed the same dim parameter.
Single chat-model construction point get_chat_model(settings.CHAT_MODEL); pydantic-ai OpenAIChatModel requires a concrete name — basis of the startup-resolution design.
Settings conventions, CHAT_MODEL/EMBEDDING_DIM/SEARCH_* fields; CHAT_MODEL becomes optional; no post-init validators exist.
_build_retriever is the single choke point for SEARCH_* thresholds; build_* factories construct services with model names — profile override and effective-model wiring sites.
Retriever kwargs defaults; apply_profile must compose with module DEFAULT_* precedence.
pgvector column width constant EMBEDDING_DIM=1536 for the startup cross-check warning.
Lifespan where startup discovery/resolution and the fail-fast unset-chat-model error hook in.
hermetic_settings pattern for .env-proof config tests; parse_sse for any stream checks.
Gateway adapter conventions to keep consistent (quota Retry-After, capability gating) when touching llm/.
model_control_plane_resolved logging must carry identifiers/sources only — no keys or content.
